subject: Refund for duplicate $24.50 charge
body: My card was charged twice for the March subscription. Please refund the duplicate $24.50 charge.
notes: Explicit duplicate charge, refund request, and stated amount make this a clear billing refund.

subject: Incorrect $39.00 charge needs refund
body: I was billed $39.00 after I cancelled before renewal. Please refund the incorrect $39.00 charge.
notes: Explicit incorrect charge, refund request, and stated amount make this a clear billing refund.

subject: Explain February invoice
body: Please explain why my February invoice includes a prorated plan charge. I only need a breakdown of the invoice.
notes: This is a billing explanation request with no refund request or qualifying charge claim.

subject: Need a receipt for last payment
body: Could you send a receipt for my most recent subscription payment? I need it for my expense report.
notes: A receipt request is plainly billing and requires information only.

subject: When will annual plan renew?
body: My annual subscription ends next month. What date will it renew and what amount will I be charged?
notes: A renewal billing question does not request a refund.

subject: Desktop app crashes on launch
body: The desktop app closes immediately every time I open it after today's update. Please help me get it running.
notes: A repeatable application crash is a clear technical support request.

subject: CSV export returns an error
body: Exporting my project list as CSV shows error code EX-104. The export worked yesterday.
notes: A product error while exporting data is unambiguously technical.

subject: Cannot download uploaded attachment
body: The attachment in my support workspace displays a download failed message whenever I click it.
notes: A failed application download is a clear technical issue.

subject: Calendar integration stopped syncing
body: My connected calendar has not synced new meetings since this morning, although the connection remains enabled.
notes: A malfunctioning product integration is a technical support issue.

subject: Mobile app freezes on search
body: Searching for any customer freezes the mobile app for several minutes. Please help fix the search problem.
notes: An application freeze during a feature interaction is clearly technical.

subject: Reset my password
body: I forgot my password and cannot sign in. Please send the steps to reset it.
notes: A password-reset request is a straightforward account issue.

subject: Change account email address
body: I need to update the email address on my account because I no longer use my old work address.
notes: Changing account profile details is clearly an account request.

subject: Account locked after sign-in attempts
body: My account is locked after several failed sign-in attempts. How can I unlock it?
notes: An account lockout is an unambiguous account-access issue.

subject: Replace lost authenticator device
body: I lost the phone that had my authenticator app. Please tell me how to set up two-factor authentication on my new phone.
notes: Updating two-factor authentication is an account-security request.

subject: Close my account
body: I no longer need this service and want to permanently close my account. Please explain the process.
notes: An account-closure request is clearly about account management.

subject: Is this feature available on my plan?
body: Does the Team plan include shared dashboards? I would like to know before deciding whether to upgrade.
notes: A general product-capability question needs an informational reply only.

subject: What are your support hours?
body: What hours is live support available on weekdays and weekends?
notes: A question about support availability is a general inquiry.

subject: Where can I read product documentation?
body: Please point me to the beginner documentation for creating my first workspace.
notes: A documentation request is a general informational question.

subject: Do you offer a product demo?
body: Our team is evaluating the service. Do you offer a product demo before we choose a plan?
notes: A pre-purchase product question is general and does not request an account or billing action.

subject: Where should I send feedback?
body: I have a suggestion for improving the dashboard. Where can I send product feedback?
notes: Product feedback routing is a straightforward general request.
